sentences.translation: 上週末那家書店的英文小說全部打八折。

sentences.sentence: I exercise at the gym twice a week to stay fit and healthy.
sentences.translation: 我每週去健身房運動兩次來保持健康。

sentences.sentence: My parents and I have been to two countries in Asia this year already.
sentences.translation: 我和爸媽今年已經去過亞洲的兩個國家了。

sentences.sentence: I need to type this report and submit it to my boss by Friday afternoon.
sentences.translation: 我需要把這份報告打字打完，在星期五下午交給老闆。

sentences.sentence: A typhoon is approaching Taiwan this weekend, so all outdoor events are cancelled.
sentences.translation: 這週末有颱風逼近台灣，所有戶外活動都取消了。

sentences.sentence: Beauty is only skin deep; looks do not matter as much as a kind heart.
sentences.translation: 美是外在的，外表不如善良的心來得重要。

sentences.sentence: My uncle works as an engineer and travels abroad for business often.
sentences.translation: 我叔叔是工程師，經常因公出差國外。

sentences.sentence: The cat is hiding under the table because it is afraid of the loud thunder.
sentences.translation: 小貓躲在桌子底下，因為牠害怕大雷聲。

sentences.sentence: Please underline the key points in your notes to review them more easily later.
sentences.translation: 請在筆記上標記重點，方便之後複習。

sentences.sentence: The underpass near the station keeps us dry when we cross during rainy days.
sentences.translation: 車站附近的人行地下道在下雨天能讓我們保持乾燥。

sentences.sentence: I do not fully understand this grammar rule; could you explain it once more?
sentences.translation: 我沒有完全理解這個文法規則，你能再解釋一次嗎？

sentences.sentence: I need to buy some new underwear and socks at the department store today.
sentences.translation: 今天我需要在百貨公司買一些新的內衣和襪子。

sentences.sentence: Students are required to wear the school uniform during weekdays.
sentences.translation: 學生在平日需要穿著學校制服。

sentences.sentence: Each person has a unique personality that makes them special in their own way.
sentences.translation: 每個人都有獨特的個性，讓他們以自己的方式與眾不同。

sentences.sentence: This unit covers the topic of daily routines and time expressions in English.
sentences.translation: 這個單元涵蓋日常生活和時間表達的英文用法。

sentences.sentence: The universe is so vast that scientists are still discovering new things about it.
sentences.translation: 宇宙非常廣闊，科學家仍在不斷發現新的事物。

sentences.sentence: My dream is to study at a good university abroad after I graduate from high school.
sentences.translation: 我的夢想是高中畢業後去國外的好大學唸書。

sentences.sentence: I will wait at the library until you finish your part of the group project.
sentences.translation: 我會在圖書館等你完成小組專案你的部分。

sentences.sentence: Wake up early tomorrow morning to catch the beautiful sunrise at the beach.
sentences.translation: 明天早起去海邊看美麗的日出吧。

sentences.sentence: Please upload your completed assignment to the online platform before the deadline.
sentences.translation: 請在截止日前把完成的作業上傳到線上平台。

sentences.sentence: Upon arriving at the hotel, we were warmly welcomed by the staff.
sentences.translation: 一抵達飯店，我們就受到了工作人員的熱情歡迎。

sentences.sentence: The upper floors of the building offer a much better view of the city.
sentences.translation: 大樓的上層可以欣賞到更美的城市景色。

sentences.sentence: My bedroom is upstairs, so it is quieter than the living room downstairs.
sentences.translation: 我的臥室在樓上，所以比樓下的客廳安靜。

sentences.sentence: My parents always encourage us to try new things and never give up.
sentences.translation: 爸媽總是鼓勵我們嘗試新事物，不要放棄。

sentences.sentence: My older sister is currently studying in the USA at a well-known university.
sentences.translation: 我姐姐目前在美國的一所知名大學讀書。

sentences.sentence: Learning how to use a computer is an essential skill in today's world.
sentences.translation: 學會使用電腦在現今社會是必備的技能。

sentences.sentence: I am not used to waking up so early, but I am trying to adjust.
sentences.translation: 我不習慣這麼早起床，但我正在努力適應。

sentences.sentence: The English dictionary you gave me is very useful for my vocabulary learning.
sentences.translation: 你送我的那本英文字典對我的單字學習非常有用。

sentences.sentence: Every user needs to create a password to log into the school online system.
sentences.translation: 每位使用者都需要建立密碼才能登入學校的線上系統。

sentences.sentence: My usual breakfast is a bowl of oatmeal with fresh fruit and milk.
sentences.translation: 我平常的早餐是一碗燕麥片配新鮮水果和牛奶。

sentences.sentence: I usually finish my homework right after school before I start any other activities.
sentences.translation: 我通常放學後馬上寫完作業，才開始其他活動。

sentences.sentence: During summer vacation, I plan to visit my grandparents in the countryside.
sentences.translation: 暑假期間，我计划和爺爺奶奶在鄉下待一段時間。

sentences.sentence: The whole family baked cookies together on Valentine’s Day.
sentences.translation: 我們全家在情人節那天一起烤餅乾。

sentences.sentence: The valley between the two mountains was covered with green trees and colorful flowers.
sentences.translation: 兩座山之間的山谷覆蓋著翠綠的樹林和五彩繽紛的花朵。

sentences.sentence: I truly value the friendship I have with my best friend from elementary school.
sentences.translation: 我很珍惜和小學以來最好的朋友之間的友誼。

sentences.sentence: Eating more vegetable every day is a healthy habit that everyone should follow.
sentences.translation: 每天多吃蔬菜是每個人都應該養成的好習慣。

sentences.sentence: The street vendor on the corner sells the most delicious oyster omelets in town.
sentences.translation: 轉角那個路邊攤老闆賣的蚵仔煎是全城最好吃的。

sentences.sentence: This cake is very tasty; it must have been made with a lot of care.
sentences.translation: 這塊蛋糕非常好吃，一定是花了很多心思做的。

sentences.sentence: The police officer wore a bulletproof vest while on duty for safety.
sentences.translation: 那位警察執勤時穿著防彈背心以確保安全。

sentences.sentence: Our team achieved a great victory in the basketball tournament this year.
sentences.translation: 我們球隊今年在籃球賽中取得了很大的勝利。

sentences.sentence: I recorded a video of our family trip to document all the happy memories.
sentences.translation: 我錄了一段家庭旅遊的影片來記錄所有快樂的回憶。

sentences.sentence: The view from the top of the mountain is absolutely breathtaking at sunrise.
sentences.translation: 從山頂俯瞰的景色在日出時分美得令人窒息。

sentences.sentence: Rice vinegar mixed with sugar makes a delicious dipping sauce for dumplings.
sentences.translation: 糖醋加在一起可以做成美味的餃子沾醬。

sentences.sentence: She has been playing the violin since she was six years old and is very talented.
sentences.translation: 她從六歲就開始拉小提琴，而且非常有天分。

sentences.sentence: Every visitor to our school is impressed by the beautiful campus garden.
sentences.translation: 每位來訪者都對我們學校美麗的校園花園印象深刻。

sentences.sentence: Expanding your vocabulary is one of the best ways to improve your English.
sentences.translation: 擴充詞彙量是提升英文能力最好的方法之一。

meaning: 聲音、聲音表達、表達意見

sentences.sentence: Her voice is so beautiful that everyone in the concert hall fell silent when she sang.
sentences.translation: 她的歌聲太美了，音樂廳裡的每個人都安靜下來聆聽。

sentences.sentence: Playing volleyball on the beach during sunset is one of my favorite summer activities.
sentences.translation: 在海灘上打排球、欣賞日落，是我最喜歡的夏日活動之一。

sentences.sentence: Please turn down the volume on your phone when you are in the library.
sentences.translation: 在圖書館裡請把手機音量關小。

meaning: 投票、選票、投票選舉、表決

sentences.sentence: Every citizen has the right to vote in the national election to choose their leader.
sentences.translation: 每位公民都有權利在全國大選中投票，選擇他們的領導人。

sentences.sentence: As a responsible voter, my father always studies each candidate's policies before voting.
sentences.translation: 身為負責任的選民，我爸爸投票前都會研究每位候選人的政見。

sentences.sentence: Doing regular exercise can help you keep your waist slim and stay healthy.
sentences.translation: 規律運動可以幫助你保持腰圍纖細並維持健康。

sentences.sentence: The waiter at this restaurant is very friendly and serves dishes with a smile.
sentences.translation: 這家餐廳的服務員非常友善，總是笑臉迎人地端菜。

sentences.sentence: The waitress recommended the chef's special pasta to us and we loved it.
sentences.translation: 服務生推薦我們廚師特製的義大利麵，我們非常喜歡。

sentences.sentence: I usually wake up at six in the morning to go jogging before school.
sentences.translation: 我通常早上六點起床，在上學前去慢跑。

sentences.sentence: My little sister drew a picture on the wall of her bedroom with crayons.
sentences.translation: 我妹妹用蠟筆在她的臥室牆壁上畫了一幅畫。

sentences.sentence: I lost my wallet on the bus, but a kind stranger returned it to me the next day.
sentences.translation: 我在公車上掉了錢包，但一位好心人在隔天歸還給我了。

sentences.sentence: I want to travel around Taiwan during the summer break to explore different cities.
sentences.translation: 我想在暑假環島旅行，探索不同的城市。

sentences.sentence: War brings great suffering to people, and everyone hopes for lasting peace.
sentences.translation: 戰爭帶給人們極大的苦難，每個人都希望能永保和平。

sentences.sentence: A warm bowl of chicken soup always makes me feel better when I am sick.
sentences.translation: 一碗溫熱的雞湯總能在我生病的時候讓我舒服一些。

sentences.sentence: Remember to wash your hands thoroughly before and after eating your meal.
sentences.translation: 記得吃飯前和吃完飯後要把手徹底洗乾淨。

sentences.sentence: It is important not to waste food when many people around the world are still hungry.
sentences.translation: 當世界上還有很多人在挨餓時，不浪費食物是很重要的。

sentences.sentence: I like to watch the sunrise from my balcony with a cup of hot coffee.
sentences.translation: 我喜歡在陽台端著熱咖啡看日出。

sentences.sentence: Drinking enough water every day is essential for maintaining good health.
sentences.translation: 每天喝足夠的水對維持健康非常重要。

sentences.sentence: We hiked for two hours to reach the beautiful waterfall deep in the forest.
sentences.translation: 我們健行了兩個小時才抵達森林深處的美麗瀑布。

sentences.sentence: Nothing beats a cold slice of watermelon on a hot summer day.
sentences.translation: 在大熱天裡，沒有什麼比一片冰西瓜更棒的了。

meaning: 浪、波浪、揮手；波動、波濤、揮動

sentences.sentence: The children ran to the shore to play in the waves at the beach.
sentences.translation: 孩子們跑到海邊，在海浪裡玩耍。

sentences.sentence: The best way to learn English is to practice speaking with native speakers.
sentences.translation: 學英文最好的方法是和母語人士練習口說。

sentences.sentence: We decided to go camping this weekend to enjoy nature together.
sentences.translation: 我們決定這週末一起去露營，享受大自然。

sentences.sentence: I felt very weak after the long fever and needed to rest for several days.
sentences.translation: 長時間發燒後我感到非常虛弱，需要休息好幾天。

sentences.sentence: Books and knowledge are more powerful weapons than any sword in history.
sentences.translation: 書籍和知識比歷史上任何一把劍都更有力量。

sentences.sentence: You should wear comfortable shoes when you go hiking on the mountain trails.
sentences.translation: 走山路健行時，應該穿舒適的鞋子。

sentences.sentence: My cousin's wedding will be held in a beautiful garden by the sea.
sentences.translation: 我表姐的婚禮將在海邊的美麗花園裡舉行。

sentences.sentence: Wednesday is my favorite day of the week because I have music class.
sentences.translation: 星期三是我每週最喜歡的一天，因為有音樂課。

sentences.sentence: This week has been very busy with exams and after-school club activities.
sentences.translation: 這週考試和課後社團活動很多，非常忙碌。

sentences.sentence: On weekdays I wake up early, but on weekends I love to sleep in.
sentences.translation: 平日我都很早起，但週末我喜歡睡懶覺。

sentences.sentence: My family has a weekly dinner together every Friday to catch up with each other.
sentences.translation: 我家每週五都會一起吃晚餐，互相關心彼此的生活。

sentences.sentence: I have been paying more attention to my weight since the doctor advised me to exercise more.
sentences.translation: 自從醫生建議我多運動後，我開始更注意體重了。

sentences.sentence: My grandmother is ninety years old but she is still very well and active.
sentences.translation: 我奶奶九十歲了，但身體仍然很健康且充滿活力。

sentences.sentence: The sun sets in the west, painting the sky with beautiful orange and red colors.
sentences.translation: 太陽從西邊落下，把天空染成美麗的橙紅色。

meaning: 西方的、西部的、西部電影

sentences.sentence: Western movies usually feature large open landscapes and adventurous stories.
sentences.translation: 西部電影通常以寬廣的風景和充滿冒險的故事為特色。

sentences.sentence: The ground is still wet from last night's rain, so be careful not to slip.
sentences.translation: 昨晚下雨後地面還是濕的，小心不要滑倒。

sentences.sentence: We were lucky enough to see a blue whale swimming in the ocean during our boat trip.
sentences.translation: 我們在搭船時很幸運地看到一隻藍鯨在海裡游泳。

sentences.sentence: What is your favorite season and why do you enjoy it the most?
sentences.translation: 你最喜歡哪個季節？為什麼？

sentences.sentence: Whatever you decide to do, I will support you all the way to the end.
sentences.translation: 無論你決定做什麼，我都會全力支持你到底。

meaning: 輪子、方向盤、用輪子運輸

sentences.sentence: The wheel of the shopping cart is broken and it makes a loud noise when I push it.
sentences.translation: 購物車的輪子壞了，推的時候會發出很大聲。

sentences.sentence: When do you usually finish your homework and start getting ready for bed?
sentences.translation: 你通常什麼時候寫完作業，開始準備睡覺？

sentences.sentence: Where would you like to travel this summer if you had the chance to go anywhere?
sentences.translation: 如果有機會去任何地方，你今年夏天想去哪裡旅行？

sentences.sentence: I am not sure whether I should take the bus or the train to get to the airport.
sentences.translation: 我不確定應該搭公車還是火車去機場。

meaning: 哪一個、那一個、哪個、那個

sentences.sentence: Which subject do you find the most interesting among all the ones you are studying?
sentences.translation: 在所有你正在學習的科目中，你最喜歡哪一科？

meaning: 同時、在此期間；花費（時間）、度過（時間）；當、當…的時候、一段時間

sentences.sentence: While I was waiting for my friend at the cafe, I read an interesting book.
sentences.translation: 我在咖啡廳等朋友的時候，看了一本有趣的書。

sentences.sentence: The white snow covered the entire mountain and made everything look magical.
sentences.translation: 白雪覆蓋了整座山，讓一切看起來如夢似幻。

sentences.sentence: Who is the person you admire the most and what have you learned from them?
sentences.translation: 你最敬佩的人是誰？從他們身上學到了什麼？

sentences.sentence: I spent the whole afternoon studying for the upcoming English exam.
sentences.translation: 我花了整個下午為即將到來的英文考試做準備。

sentences.sentence: Whom did you ask for help when you had trouble with your science project?
sentences.translation: 你的科學專題遇到困難時，向誰尋求了幫助？

sentences.sentence: Whose backpack is this? It has been left on the bench for a long time.
sentences.translation: 這是誰的背包？它放在長椅上很久了。

sentences.sentence: Why do you think reading books is important for personal growth and development?
sentences.translation: 你為什麼認為閱讀對個人成長和發展很重要？

sentences.sentence: The river is very wide here, so we need to take a boat to cross to the other side.
sentences.translation: 這裡的河很寬廣，我們需要搭船才能到對岸。

sentences.sentence: Traveling to different countries can widen your perspective on the world.
sentences.translation: 到不同國家旅行可以拓寬你對世界的視野。

sentences.sentence: The teacher asked us to measure the width and length of the desk for the math assignment.
sentences.translation: 老師要求我們測量課桌的寬度和長度，作為數學作業。

sentences.sentence: My uncle and his wife love to cook together and try new recipes every weekend.
sentences.translation: 我叔叔和嬸嬸喜歡每週末一起下廚，嘗試新食譜。

sentences.sentence: Wild animals should be observed from a safe distance and never fed by humans.
sentences.translation: 野生動物應該保持安全距離觀察，切勿餵食。

sentences.sentence: I will visit my grandparents in Tainan next month if my schedule allows.
sentences.translation: 如果時間允許，我下個月會去台南探望爺爺奶奶。

sentences.sentence: Are you willing to volunteer at the community center this weekend?
sentences.translation: 這週末你願意去社區中心擔任志工嗎？

sentences.sentence: Our school basketball team did their best and finally won the championship trophy.
sentences.translation: 我們學校的籃球隊全力以赴，最終贏得了冠軍獎杯。

sentences.sentence: The strong wind blew my umbrella inside out while I was walking to school.
sentences.translation: 我走去學校的途中，強風把我的傘吹翻了。

sentences.sentence: It was so windy at the beach that flying a kite was great fun for the kids.
sentences.translation: 海邊風很大，孩子們放風箏非常開心。

sentences.sentence: Red wine paired with grilled steak at a fine restaurant makes a wonderful dinner.
sentences.translation: 在高級餐廳裡，紅酒配烤牛排是完美的晚餐組合。

sentences.sentence: The butterfly opened its colorful wings and flew gracefully across the garden.
sentences.translation: 蝴蝶張開五彩繽紛的翅膀，在花園裡優雅地飛舞。

sentences.sentence: The winner of the singing competition received a trophy and a gift card.
sentences.translation: 歌唱比賽的冠軍獲得了一座獎杯和一張禮券。

sentences.sentence: My grandfather is a wise man who always gives me thoughtful advice when I am confused.
sentences.translation: 我爺爺是個很有智慧的人，每當我迷茫的時候都會給我深思熟慮的建議。

sentences.sentence: I wish you a happy birthday and all the best for your new journey ahead.
sentences.translation: 祝你有個愉快的生日，也祝你在新的人生旅程中一切順利。

sentences.sentence: I enjoy studying English with my classmates because we can practice speaking together.
sentences.translation: 我喜歡和同學一起學英文，因為我們可以一起練習口說。

sentences.sentence: Please finish your test within the time limit of ninety minutes.
sentences.translation: 請在九十分鐘的時限內完成測驗。

sentences.sentence: It is hard to imagine life without the internet in today's modern world.
sentences.translation: 在現今的現代世界，很難想像沒有網路的生活會是什麼樣子。

sentences.sentence: A hot wok is the key to making perfect stir-fried vegetables with a smoky flavor.
sentences.translation: 火候夠熱的炒鍋是做出完美帶有焦香炒蔬菜的關鍵。

sentences.sentence: The wolf is a wild animal that usually lives in forests and mountains.
sentences.translation: 狼是一種通常生活在森林和山區的野生動物。

sentences.sentence: The young woman who works at the bookstore always recommends great books to customers.
sentences.translation: 在書店工作的那位年輕女士總是向顧客推薦很棒的書。

sentences.sentence: Could you tell me where the women’s room is in this station?
sentences.translation: 請問這個車站的女廁在哪裡？

sentences.sentence: I wonder why the sky changes color during different times of the day.
sentences.translation: 我很好奇為什麼天空在不同時段會變色。

sentences.sentence: The old wooden table has been in my family for over fifty years.
sentences.translation: 這張老舊的木桌在我家流傳了五十多年。

sentences.sentence: The wooden floor in the traditional house creaked when we walked on it.
sentences.translation: 我們走在傳統老屋的木地板上時，地板發出吱吱聲。

sentences.sentence: I looked up a new word in the dictionary to understand its meaning and usage.
sentences.translation: 我在字典裡查了一個新單字來了解它的意思和用法。

sentences.sentence: Hard work and dedication are more important than natural talent in the long run.
sentences.translation: 長遠來看，勤奮和奉獻比天賦更重要。

sentences.sentence: I finished all the exercises in the math workbook ahead of schedule.
sentences.translation: 我提前完成了數學練習冊裡的所有題目。

sentences.sentence: The construction worker started very early in the morning to finish the building on time.
sentences.translation: 建築工人一大早就開始工作，確保大樓能準時完工。

sentences.sentence: The internet connects people from all over the world and makes communication easier.
sentences.translation: 網路連接了全世界的人，讓溝通變得更方便。

sentences.sentence: My cold got worse after I stayed up late studying for my exams.
sentences.translation: 因為熬夜準備考試，我的感冒變得更嚴重了。

sentences.sentence: That was the worst movie I have ever seen; I would not recommend it to anyone.
sentences.translation: 那是我看過最糟糕的電影，我不會推薦給任何人。

sentences.sentence: This ancient temple is definitely worth visiting if you are interested in history.
sentences.translation: 如果你對歷史有興趣，這座古寺絕對值得參觀。

sentences.sentence: Would you like to join us for a hike this weekend in the mountains?
sentences.translation: 這週末要不要和我們一起去山上健行？

sentences.sentence: The doctor cleaned the wound carefully and put a bandage on it.
sentences.translation: 醫生仔細清洗了傷口，並貼上繃帶。

sentences.sentence: I wore a wrist support because I strained my wrist while playing tennis.
sentences.translation: 我因為打網球扭傷了手腕，所以戴了護腕。

sentences.sentence: My dream is to become a writer who writes stories that inspire and entertain people.
sentences.translation: 我的夢想是成為一位能啟發和娛樂讀者的作家。

meaning: 錯誤的、不正確的、不對的

sentences.sentence: I wrote the wrong date on the form and had to fill it out again.
sentences.translation: 我在表格上寫錯了日期，所以必須重新填寫。

sentences.sentence: My grandfather grows beautiful flowers and vegetables in his backyard yard.
sentences.translation: 我爺爺在後院種植美麗的花朵和蔬菜。

sentences.sentence: Yeah, I agree that this restaurant has the best dumplings in the whole city.
sentences.translation: 對啊，我同意這家餐廳的水餃是全城最好吃的。

sentences.sentence: This year has been full of challenges, but also many wonderful memories.
sentences.translation: 這一年充滿挑戰，但也有很多美好的回憶。

sentences.sentence: Our school holds a sports meet yearly to encourage students to stay active.
sentences.translation: 我們學校每年都會舉辦運動會，鼓勵學生保持活力。

sentences.sentence: The yellow fields of sunflowers attract many tourists to the countryside every summer.
sentences.translation: 每年夏天，金黃色的向日葵花田吸引許多遊客到鄉下遊玩。

sentences.sentence: Yes, I would love to try that traditional dish you have been telling me about.
sentences.translation: 好啊，我很想去試試你一直跟我說的那道傳統料理。

sentences.sentence: I have not finished my homework yet, so I cannot go out to play with my friends.
sentences.translation: 我還沒寫完作業，所以不能出去玩。

sentences.sentence: You are the best friend anyone could ever wish for in their life.
sentences.translation: 你是每個人一生中最希望能擁有的最好的朋友。

sentences.sentence: Your effort in learning a new language will surely pay off in the future.
sentences.translation: 你學習新語言的努力，未來一定會有所回報。

sentences.sentence: That backpack on the chair looks similar to yours; is it actually yours?
sentences.translation: 椅子上那個背包看起來和你得很像，那是你的嗎？

sentences.sentence: You should be proud of yourself for working so hard and achieving your goals.
sentences.translation: 你應該為自己的努力和達成目標感到自豪。

sentences.sentence: Youth is a time to explore, learn, and build memories that will last a lifetime.
sentences.translation: 青春是用來探索、學習，並建立一生難忘回憶的時光。

sentences.sentence: The homemade mango ice cream was so yummy that I asked for the recipe.
sentences.translation: 自製的芒果冰淇淋太好吃了，我還要了食譜。

sentences.sentence: The zebra at the zoo has a unique black and white pattern that stands out.
sentences.translation: 動物園裡的斑馬有著獨特的黑白條紋，非常醒目。

sentences.sentence: The volcano is very high and sometimes it erupts.
sentences.translation: 這座火山很高，有時會噴發。

sentences.sentence: Good teamwork helps us finish the project faster.
sentences.translation: 良好的團隊合作幫助我們更快完成專案。

sentences.sentence: He looked at the stars through the telescope.
sentences.translation: 他用望遠鏡觀看星星。

sentences.sentence: My sister is always cheerful in the morning.
sentences.translation: 我姊姊早上總是很愉快。

sentences.sentence: This old book is very valuable to me.
sentences.translation: 這本舊書對我來說非常珍貴。

sentences.sentence: The journey to the mountain took three hours.
sentences.translation: 前往那座山的旅程花了三個小時。

sentences.sentence: We want to explore the forest this weekend.
sentences.translation: 我們這個週末想去探索森林。
